author: _ArmyFrog
body:
Hello There! I am submitting this map for the contest, hopefully I am not too late. Anyway, what I have here is a traditional Japanese themed map with dozens of unique structures such as sakura trees along with a unique layout. I have packaged the whole map, and it is ready to be used (it has been tested, although it would be wise to check for errors). I hope you guys enjoy this map, and take it into consideration in the competition. If there is anything else you need, please let me know.

Map Album: http://imgur.com/a/gY7n6

Map Download. https://www.mediafire.com/?ppmmmeznr3d3m8n
